Mahjong hand evaluation and scoring

@kobalab/majiang-core 1.4.1 by Satoshi Kobayashi
Upstream: https://github.com/kobalab/majiang-core
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kobalab/majiang-core
License: MIT; full license in LICENSE.majiang-core.txt
npm tarball SHA-1: e558c3a7408f8437e56e1d3c872ba8d06f317680

majiang-core.mjs is a browser ES module bundle of the upstream Shoupai,
rule, xiangting and hule modules and their dependencies. No rules were
modified in the vendored code. The game configures its no-red/no-calls
two-player arcade variant in engine.mjs. It does not fetch code from a CDN.

3D table rendering

three-table.mjs bundles Three.js 0.180.0 and its RoundedBoxGeometry add-on
into one browser ES module. The MIT license is in LICENSE.three.txt.
The source package is pinned in this repository's webcraft777/package-lock.json.
The build uses esbuild with format=esm, target=es2022, bundle and minify.
Entry module:
  export * from 'three';
  export {RoundedBoxGeometry} from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';
Tile illustrations, felt, wood and the room are generated by Seven Mahjong.
